backtest_cases.request_description: URGENT: last night's storm brought down a large tree that is now blocking the rear fire exit. GreenScape quote: ₹38,000 fixed, all-inclusive (cutting, crane, disposal). Can start today.
backtest_cases.why: Alarming wording, clean case: small, fixed price, existing vendor, safety. Tests over-caution.
